description: Wallet Tasks 1-2: Pin MCP SDK, freeze consent attestation semantics, scaffold wallet packages (wallet-domain, wallet-application, wallet-contracts), and update apps/local-mcp with MCP SDK dependency
steps: Task 1 - Pin MCP SDK: Add @modelcontextprotocol/sdk as a dependency to apps/local-mcp/package.json with exact version (use latest stable, e.g., 1.12.1 - check what's available in node_modules or lockfile). Use stdio transport profile.

Task 1 - Consent attestation semantics: Add a consent attestation type definition in packages/trust-protocol matching the existing CTP_OBJECT_TYPES entry 'counter.principal-consent-attestation.v1'. The PrincipalConsentAttestationPayload already exists in types.ts - ensure it includes: exact digest of consented content, authentication method, assurance level, auth timestamp, audience, expiry, nonce, and revocation locator fields.

Task 2 - Create packages/wallet-domain package: Create package.json (name: @counter/wallet-domain, deps: @counter/domain workspace:*), tsconfig.json extending ../../tsconfig.base.json, src/index.ts barrel. Define wallet lifecycle states (INVITED, ENROLLED, VERIFIED, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, RECOVERY_LOCKED, OFFBOARDING, CLOSED) with type guards and transition validation. Define WalletAccount, WalletPrincipal, WalletInvitation value object interfaces.

Task 2 - Create packages/wallet-application package: Create package.json (name: @counter/wallet-application, deps: @counter/domain, @counter/wallet-domain, @counter/wallet-contracts, @counter/trust-protocol, @counter/authorization all workspace:*), tsconfig.json, src/index.ts barrel. Define application service ports/interfaces for wallet lifecycle management, invitation flow, and consent attestation.

Task 2 - Create packages/wallet-contracts package: Create package.json (name: @counter/wallet-contracts, deps: @counter/domain, @counter/contracts all workspace:*), tsconfig.json, src/index.ts barrel. Define API contract types for wallet endpoints (create, invite, enroll, verify, status, suspend, close).

Task 2 - Update apps/local-mcp: Add @modelcontextprotocol/sdk dependency, add @counter/wallet-domain and @counter/wallet-contracts as workspace deps. Update src/index.ts to configure the MCP server with stdio transport and basic tool registration skeleton.
Ensure pnpm-workspace.yaml already covers packages/* (it does). Run pnpm install to resolve workspace links.
Add index.test.ts files for each new package with at least package identity and basic type validation tests.

Update .dependency-cruiser.cjs if needed: wallet packages must not import from merchant implementation packages (shopify-connector, razorpay-adapter, reference-connector, merchant-application, merchant-policy).
Run pnpm build, pnpm test, pnpm lint, pnpm depcruise to verify everything passes.
acceptance_criteria: packages/wallet-domain builds with tsc and exports wallet lifecycle states, WalletAccount, WalletPrincipal, WalletInvitation types
packages/wallet-application builds and exports service port interfaces
packages/wallet-contracts builds and exports wallet API contract types
apps/local-mcp has @modelcontextprotocol/sdk dependency and a working MCP server skeleton with stdio transport
Principal consent attestation CTP type is complete with all required fields (digest, auth method, assurance, time, audience, expiry, nonce, revocation)
No circular dependencies or boundary violations in depcruise
All tests pass including new package tests

The 3 new wallet packages bring the workspace to 34 projects total. All verifications pass: build (0 errors), test (all pass including 26+9+10+5 tests in new packages), lint (0 errors), depcruise (no violations, 1295 modules).
